metadata.purpose: Protect privileged lab activity from credential phishing, adversary-in-the-middle interception, and MFA fatigue by requiring a phishing-resistant authentication method.
metadata.scope: The shared LAB_ADMINS_GROUP_ID group, for all cloud apps and all client app types. This pilot group is used instead of tenant-wide directory roles to bound lockout risk.
metadata.exclusions: The shared emergency-access group only; routine admin exceptions are intentionally not defined.
metadata.controls: Require the tenant-verified built-in Phishing-resistant MFA authentication strength.
prerequisites: Microsoft Entra ID P1 or qualifying suite licences for in-scope administrators
At least two usable phishing-resistant methods are registered per pilot admin where feasible
Passkey (FIDO2), Windows Hello for Business, or certificate-based authentication is enabled and tested
Emergency-access accounts exist, are independently secured, monitored, and tested
The authentication-strength object ID is verified in the target tenant
metadata.expectedUserImpact: An administrator whose current authentication does not satisfy the selected strength must use an allowed phishing-resistant method. SMS, voice, TOTP, and push alone do not satisfy this policy. Report-only mode does not enforce the requirement.
metadata.owner: Zero Trust Identity & Conditional Access Lab
